fact: The Togo Digital 2025 strategy (French version, June 2022) includes a programme of access to very high speed broadband and equipment for all, with an investment of USD 250-300M and operating budget of USD 15-25M to 2025, within a total strategy budget of USD 0.8-1 billion.
title: Togo Digital 2025
publisher: Ministère de l'Economie Numérique et de la Transformation Digitale
